concept.name: Ying Wing Athlete
concept.description: Premium sports-luxury Open Graph artwork with a young female Sanda athlete seen from behind, a defined eagle wing on the right, restrained gold/red ink accents and exact Arianna Milano / Sanda Athlete / Ying identity copy.
visualReferences: site eagle artwork: black/ivory/red/gold ink aesthetic
Ying hero artwork: dark background, satin gold, eagle/wing symbolism
approved mixed concept: rear-view athlete + wing + restrained typography

athlete.pose: rear-view, centered, calm ready stance, arms relaxed but prepared
athlete.clothing: plain black Sanda top and black shorts with restrained dark-red waistband/details
athlete.gloves: plain dark-red Sanda gloves, no visible brand or lettering
athlete.notes: No WEISING branding. No ideogram on clothing. Keep silhouette clean and credible. Reduce empty headroom by moving athlete upward rather than enlarging excessively.

wing.definition: high feather definition with ink-brush edges
wing.notes: Wing should be approximately 12% smaller than the previous approved draft. Keep feather definition, but athlete must remain the primary subject.

largeIdeogram.renderMethod: vector/text overlay after AI artwork generation
largeIdeogram.notes: Do not let the image generator invent the ideogram. Use exact simplified Chinese 鹰, consistent with the site identity.

background.texture: subtle paper, ink and sports-campaign grain
background.redAccents: minimal diagonal ink strokes concentrated on lower-right/right edge

typography.notes: Use the same premium modern sans-serif family as the site where possible. Exact ideogram is 鹰.

aiArtwork.prompt: Wide cinematic premium sports-branding artwork for a young female Sanda athlete, seen from behind, centered and slightly raised in frame, calm ready stance, dark ponytail, plain black Sanda top and plain black shorts with restrained dark-red details, plain dark-red gloves with absolutely no logos or lettering. Deep black and charcoal environment, subtle paper and ink texture, warm satin-gold rim light defining hair and shoulders. On the right, one large eagle wing only, not a full eagle, with clearly defined realistic feathers transitioning into expressive black, warm-ivory and satin-gold Chinese ink brush textures, roughly 12 percent smaller than in the prior draft, integrated naturally into the darkness. Minimal deep-red ink strokes near the lower-right edge, restrained gold particles, luxury contemporary athlete campaign, Nike/Red-Bull/Olympic athlete portfolio level, disciplined, elegant, cinematic, strong negative space on the left for typography. No text anywhere in the image, no Chinese characters, no logos, no brands, no writing on clothing, no symbols on shorts.
aiArtwork.negativePrompt: adult-looking athlete, bodybuilder physique, sexualized pose, exposed branding, WEISING logo, text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, ideogram on clothing, full eagle, eagle head, giant bird, mountains, temples, fantasy armor, flames, excessive smoke, excessive red, excessive gold, clutter, childlike graphics, cartoon, anime, low-detail feathers, malformed hands, extra limbs, duplicate gloves
aiArtwork.style: cinematic realistic sports campaign blended with refined Chinese ink-art textures
aiArtwork.lighting: warm rim light, deep controlled shadows, no bright arena floodlights
aiArtwork.camera: rear three-quarter/rear view, eye-level to slightly low, medium-wide

steps: Generate artwork without any text or ideograms.
Crop/fit to 1200x630 while preserving athlete center and full readable wing on right.
Apply exact typography block on left.
Overlay exact simplified ideogram 鹰 on right at specified position.
Check all text and key visual elements remain inside safe area.
Export optimized social image in WebP and PNG/JPEG fallback as needed.

mustHave: athlete clearly reads as a young Sanda athlete
typography sits slightly higher than previous draft
reduced empty space above athlete head
premium black/ivory/gold/dark-red visual language consistent with site
rejectIf: wrong/traditional ideogram 鷹 appears instead of 鹰
